name: Brevo
description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an integrated marketing and CRM platform that combines email, SMS, WhatsApp, live chat, and customer relationship management with volume-based pricing based on emails sent rather than contacts stored.
best_for: Positioned for businesses with large contact lists that want a pay-per-email pricing model, European GDPR compliance, built-in CRM, and multi-channel messaging across WhatsApp and SMS.
features: Email marketing campaign creation with drag-and-drop visual builder and responsive templates
Volume-based pricing based on monthly email sends with unlimited contact storage
SMS marketing and WhatsApp business broadcast campaigns
Visual marketing automation workflows with event tracking and triggers
Built-in CRM for managing contacts, pipelines, and deal stages
On-site live chat and conversation inbox for customer support

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Includes 300 emails/day, unlimited contact storage, email templates, and transactional email capabilities.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Starts at $9/month for 5,000 emails/month with no daily sending limit and basic reporting.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Starts at $18/month for 5,000 emails/month. Adds marketing automation workflows, A/B testing, landing page builder, and multi-user access.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: High-volume enterprise tier with advanced analytics, dedicated IP, SLA, and sub-account management.

pros: Charges by email sending volume rather than contact count, making it highly economical for large contact lists
Permanent free plan offering 300 emails/day with unlimited stored contacts
Integrated WhatsApp and SMS channels natively supported alongside email and CRM
cons: Daily sending cap of 300 emails on the free plan
Removing Brevo branding from emails requires a paid add-on on lower tiers
SMS and WhatsApp message credits are billed separately

faq.question: Is Brevo free?
faq.answer: Yes, Brevo has a permanent free plan that allows you to send up to 300 emails per day to an unlimited number of stored contacts.

faq.question: How does Brevo pricing differ from Mailchimp?
faq.answer: While Mailchimp charges based on total contact list size regardless of how often you email them, Brevo charges primarily for the number of emails actually sent per month.

faq.question: Can I send WhatsApp and SMS messages with Brevo?
faq.answer: Yes, Brevo natively supports transactional and promotional SMS and WhatsApp campaigns, with credits purchased as pay-as-you-go add-ons.

alternatives.name: Moosend
alternatives.description: An email marketing and automation platform offering unlimited email sends on Pro subscription tiers.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting unlimited monthly sends for a fixed subscriber count starting at $9/month

alternatives.name: Constant Contact
alternatives.description: A digital and email marketing platform for small businesses, with email, SMS, landing pages, and event marketing.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses and nonprofits wanting event promotion and dedicated phone support

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining analytics, automations, and AI tools for integrated customer communications.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a wide template library and broad third-party application ecosystem
